scope: 1959-01-13 SNU institutional reorganization: legal basis, nursing/public-administration routing, and responsible offices

actors.name: 이승만
actions: The 1959-01-13 reorganization was effected through a presidential-decree layer; SNU GSPA's official history says the school was established by presidential decree in January 1959, while the current legal-history text marks the relevant National School Establishment Order provisions as newly enacted/revised on 1959-01-13.
actors.attribution_limits: Presidential-decree status proves the formal legal layer and is consistent with the contemporaneous Minnesota report's statement that Rhee approved the nursing department. It does not prove that Rhee drafted, originated, or personally designed either the GSPA or nursing reform.
open_leads: recover the exact 1959-01-13 promulgation text and decree number from official Gazette/law archive
recover cabinet agenda/minutes and presidential approval sheet
separate routine constitutional promulgation from substantive intervention

actors.name: 최재유

roles.evidence: AKS biographical entry plus contemporary/archival records placing him as education minister through 1960

actions: Held the responsible education-minister portfolio when the 1959-01-13 national-school/SNU reorganization took effect.
actors.attribution_limits: Portfolio responsibility is verified, but this pass has not recovered the cabinet proposal sheet or promulgation signature page. Do not yet label Choi the proposer, drafter, or signatory of the specific amendment.
open_leads: recover Ministry of Education proposal memorandum
recover cabinet minutes for the amendment

actors.name: 1959 서울대 의과대학장
actions: Minnesota nursing-adviser report attributes strong support for reserving a new faculty position to the Dean of Medicine.
actors.identity_note: A newly located SNU Engineering article captions 이제구 as SNU medical dean in January 1955, proving that dean and hospital-director offices must be tracked independently. It does not establish that 이제구 still held the deanship in 1959.
actors.attribution_limits: Identity remains open. 김동익's hospital-director tenure must not be substituted for the medical-dean identity.
open_leads: recover official 1958-1960 College of Medicine dean roster

actors.name: 이제구

roles.evidence: SNU Engineering article reproducing a January 1955 Minnesota Project leadership photograph and caption

actors.attribution_limits: This establishes the office in January 1955 only; continuity to 1959 is not assumed.
open_leads: check whether he was the dean referenced in the 1959 nursing report

actors.name: 1959 문교부 서울대 정원배정 담당자
actions: The nursing report establishes a Ministry-controlled new faculty-position allocation; the 1959-01-13 National School Establishment Order revision also reorganized SNU central administrative offices, including Academic Affairs functions responsible for departments, curricula, faculty/student structures.
actors.attribution_limits: The individual bureau/director responsible for the allocation remains unidentified.
open_leads: recover Ministry organization chart for January 1959
